validation_dataset_profile.name: BRFSS 2022 Lung Cancer Screening Holdout Split
validation_dataset_profile.source: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
validation_dataset_profile.collection_methodology: Complex multi-stage stratified random-digit dialing telephone survey
validation_dataset_profile.outcome_variable: _LCSREC == 2 (Recommended for LDCT but did not receive CT in past year)
validation_dataset_profile.population_characteristics: US adults aged 50-80 with >= 20 pack-years and current or former smoking within 15 years
limitations: Captures US healthcare navigation barriers (Medicare/Medicaid coverage, private insurance)
US USPSTF guideline context (not established in Bangladesh healthcare policy)

validation_protocol: PROT-VAL-EXP02-2026.1: Holdout cross-validation, PR-AUC evaluation, and healthcare access barrier disparity audit.

calibration_metrics.recalibration_rationale: Observed calibration slope 1.285 and intercept 2.501. Recalibration recommended before target population deployment.

clinical_utility_metrics.intended_use: Identify eligible individuals with high likelihood of failing to obtain annual low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) to target proactive community navigation.
clinical_utility_metrics.false_positive_clinical_cost: Community healthcare worker time spent reaching out to an individual who was already adherent.
clinical_utility_metrics.false_negative_clinical_risk: High-risk individual does not receive outreach, remaining unscreened with delayed lung cancer presentation.
clinical_utility_metrics.bangladesh_workflow_applicability: Fundamentally inapplicable. Bangladesh has no organized national LDCT lung cancer screening program or public insurance reimbursement for asymptomatic screening.

bangladesh_generalizability.evidence_gap_summary: The USPSTF lung cancer screening recommendation protocol (annual LDCT for 50-80yo with >=20 pack-years) does not exist as an operational clinical guideline or subsidized national program in Bangladesh. Applying an adherence propensity model to a non-existent clinical pathway is conceptually and operationally invalid.
missing_variables: Public health insurance claims for preventive thoracic LDCT
Standard primary care electronic referral pathways for screening
bangladesh_generalizability.prospective_requirements: Establishment of national clinical consensus guidelines and subsidized LDCT screening infrastructure before any screening adherence model can be conceptualized.

conditions_or_restrictions: Formally rejected for Bangladesh clinical decision-support and workflow integration.
May not be deployed in any clinical, community, or administrative portal within Bangladesh.
cab_review_decision.clinical_rationale: The target variable (_LCSREC) presumes the existence of an active, institutionalized USPSTF annual LDCT screening program. In Bangladesh, low-dose CT is neither subsidized, routinely available in public upazila/district hospitals, nor endorsed as a national screening program. Deploying this model would generate clinically nonsensical task assignments.

operational_activation.activation_blocked_reason: Model rejected for Bangladesh clinical use due to structural absence of underlying LDCT screening program.
